tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa la lhan thabs nag 'gros su bkod pa bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs nag po 'gro shes bklag chog tu dgod par bya ba la/ rje btsun bla ma mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ blom̐ chen khrag 'thung dgyes nyams gsam̐l mdzad cing*// sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan zlos gar gyis// rnam gsum pho nya'i drwa ba rgyam̐ mtshom̐'i sprin// spro dang sdud mdzad khyed kyi thugs rjes skyongs// 'dir mkha' spyod don du gnyer ba'i gang zag gis bsnyen pa kha bskang ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ sngags kyi nus mthu 'byin pa dang*/ mkha' spyod dngos grub skye ba 'di nyid la thob pa'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i sa phyogs kyi dbang du byas nas zhes gsungs pas sngar sa chog tshul bzhin byas pa'i lha khang dang*/ sgrub gnas rnying par sa chog mi dgos kyang*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i sar sbyin sreg byed na sa chog byas na 'jam zhing shis pas de la sa brtag slang*/ sbyang gsum gzhung gi cho ga rgyas par ma grub kyang*/ phyag len gang du bya ba'i sa gzhi der bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i cha gsum gtor ma dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma gang rung ngam mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sgrub mchod ltar btang ba la sa gzhi slang ba'i phrin bcol bgegs skrad byed/

de nas sa lha'i cho ga ni thab stegs bya ba'i sa gzhi'i dbus su dri bzang gi chu/ 'byor na ba byung lnga dang bcas pa'i chag chag dang thig le byas pa'i steng ngam/ spro na mañdzi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i steng du 'bras nas gro gang rung gis tshom bu bkod pa'i mdun du gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhi pa dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bshams la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i srin lag g.yas pa'i rtsa bar hūm̐ yig 'bar bas mtshan par gyur par bsam/ srin lag de nyid sa la bsnun pa'i stangs ka bya zhing ngag tu/ ham̐ ham̐ ham̐ zhes brjod pas sa gzhi gnon pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pas rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi las ci bgyi bka' stsal du gsol zhes gsung bzhin mdun du mngon sum du gsal bar gyur par bsams la/ de nas mchod pa la dmigs te/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai we d+ye āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī gṛh+ṇa ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī gṛh+ṇa daṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sam pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta na da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hṛ da ya ni san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tat+gaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes pas lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seṅge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag sogs dngos grub kyi mchog blang bar 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī gṛh+ṇe daṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis phul/ lag pa rdo rje dang bcas te sa la reg ste/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī badz+ra mus sa'i lha mo sa gzhi de nyid du thim pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsams la/ sa'i lha mo'i sgos mchod dang me tog tshom bu sogs bsal la gnas khang byi dor dang*/ rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ kha shar phyogs par stan nang tshang can gyi mdun du cog rtse sogs kyi khar rdor dril gyi bar du gzar bu gnyis kha sprod nas me thab bar bzhag g.yas su ḍā ma ru dang me tog phor ba/ bsang chu'i dung chos dri bzang chu 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa/ g.yon du nang mchod cog rtse'i mdun du me yol 'jim pa la dkar zhal byugs pa la waṃ yig gangs ri chu rgyun sogs bris pa bzhag mdun du zhi ba'i thab stegs zlum po bris pa'am brtsegs pa gang 'thad mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar zhes gsungs pas/ de yang bris pa las brtsigs pa sogs phyag len cher mi mdzad cing*/ las bzhi gang byed kyang thab steng stegs bu gru bzhi pa dpangs dang rgya che chung nges pa cher med kyang*/ bskyed chog ltar gyi thab dkyil bri ba la gzhi lhag par 'thas shing ngos snyoms pa'i zhal zhal byas pa dkar rtsis legs par byugs/ de steng thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par gdab/ de'i dbus na khru phyed dam mtho gang tshad kyis zlum skor dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba'i zlum skor gsum gyi nang ma thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi kha khyer/ de'i phyi mu ran/ de'i phyi sor bzhi'i tshad kyi thab stegs gru bzhi'i thig spyi dang mthun par gdab/

zlum skor dang po dang tshangs thig 'phrad pa nas dbus kyi bar gyi srad bu des zlum skor dang po'i shar gyi g.yas g.yon gang slebs su rtags bya/ nub tu yang snga ma bzhin gyi rtags byas/ shar nub kyi tshangs thig zlum skor phrad mtshams nas g.yas g.yon gyi rtags bzhi byas pa/ de'i steng thig btab pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'byung*/ de la rdul tshon nam chu tshon gyis chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dmar po/ bcad dkar po/ dbus su nyi gdan dmar ser la rdo rje dmar po sgang po'am/ yang na tshon dpung dmar po bya/ thab nang kha khyer mu ran gyi gzhi dkar po la mdangs mdzes tshon dang bcad dmar skya kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ chos 'byung gi zur drug dang zlum skor gyi phyi stegs bu gru bzhi'i thig gi nang gi mtshams bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bcas legs par bris/ kha khyer gyi steng tsam du bud shing ngam srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos khru phyed tsam zlum por brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor zan gyi ting lo'i me tshang bshams/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar bsreg rdzas yam shing sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad mthe bong las mi sbom zhing*/ mthe'u chung las mi phra ba rtsa rtse mar dang bu ram gyis byugs pa/ mar/ til/ zas mchog

ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi ra'i 'o ma/ zho mar khu bcas la tsam pa btab pa'i phye mar dang*/ yang na ril bu bya/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūr+wa/ ku sha/ chang la bdud rtse ril bu btab pa/ ba glang gi sha dum bu dmar po mar la btsos bas byas/ la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa rnams bzhag rang gi g.yon phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bcas gsum dang*/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga tshar gnyis thab kyi mthar bkram rgyu'i ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ me sbar ba'i lce lde/ dpal 'bar gyis ming*/ me gso ba'i bud shing skam po rlung g.yab dang bcas pa sogs yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par bshams/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog par 'dod na yar ngo*/ bar gcod 'joms par 'dod na mar ngo ste/ tshes bcu nyer lnga bcu gnyis gang rung gi dus khyad par can nam/ dus gang yang rung ba'i snga dro'am/ dgong mo'i cha la stan bde ba la bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes rgyal po rol stabs la zhi ba'i skyil krung bca'/ chas gos dkar po'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'am/ bsdu na stan dkar gyi steng du dar ras dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs tshul pang kheb byas la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa tshar gsum gyis srung 'khor gsal btab nas/ skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab kyi thun bsdu ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed grub rjes nang mchod gsar pa yin na 'dir byin rlabs byas la/ de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ bsang chu sgrub pa ni/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las bsang chu rdzas rnams kyi bgegs dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ma ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs so// 'di man gyi bsang ba rnams la bsang chu kho na 'thor ba yin/ mchod pa rnams/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas mang por spel/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs nas/ a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa tshar gsum gyis rol chen ḍā dril dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs so// bsreg rdzas rnams kyang*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ las so sor sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ shri swā hā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ tshar res byin gyis brlabs/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma dā na pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bā la pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes rdzas sngags tshar re brjod/ yang thab la dmigs te/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba dang*/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du e e las chos kyi 'byung nas gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi zur rnams dang phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi ba'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ de nas me sgrub pa ni/ bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me 'di bod du mi 'byor bas/ thab kyi me rgyun ma chad pa'i mes tshab bya ba phyag len no/ las sngar gyi me sbar la lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ste/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing thab la g.yon nas lan gsum bskor zhing me tshang du bcug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod/ me gso ba'i rtswa skam cung zad bzhag cing*/ rlung g.yab cung zad g.yab/ yang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes mar khu blug gzar gsum blugs te me gso/ de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni me de nyid/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dang pos dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs dang tshangs pa'i skud pas mdzes par byas pa khri snyan sā la'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa la drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang lag g.yas dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung nas g.yab cing*/ o tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi ma hā bhū ta/ de wa ri ṣi dwi dzaḥs ta ma/ gṛ hi nā ma hā asmin+sa n+ni/ hi to bha wa ag+na ye e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur bar bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ku sha/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las bsgrub pa'i nus pa ldan par bsams la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// 'dis bdag la gegs med par mdzod cig ma ma shīn+taṃ kurban+tu swā hā/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad du byas pa phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis bkram/

me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang dgang blugs kyi kha la yang ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ gzar bu gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi bar du tshud par byas te byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar lan bdun bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te thab la g.yon du bskor zhing me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam la/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya dī bya a bi ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye bdag gis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dang gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar byon zan lan gsum phul nas phyag rgyar bcas la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra dhūp+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra nai wi d+ye pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// skabs 'dir me pra brtags la/ ngan na bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ sum+bha brjod pas bsrung*/ de nas bsregs rdzas kyi snod lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la g.yon pa'i 'og nas bskor zhing 'bul ba'i tshe mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ ag+na ye lha sngags/ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa rdzas sngags/ ye swā hā/ bdag gi las sngags/ sdig sgrib bar chad sngags kyi nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ yam shing*/ de bzhin du sha dum/ bar thams cad la thog mtha' bar gsum du sngags lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags/ gsum ka sbrel ba dang gzhan rdzas sngags rkyang pas bdun sogs ci rigs pa grangs mnyam par phul te/ rdzas sngags ni/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+rā ye swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bī dza ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ye swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr+wa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ye swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ ma dā na pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ chang dang*/ oṃ bā la pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ba glang gi sha dum gyi sngags so// yang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa rī wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes mar khu blugs gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/

oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim par yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku rked yan chad kheb pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams mtha' skor du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon skor lan gsum bskor zhing*/ ngag tu phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

mdor na rdzas phul ba'i dgos pa gzi brjid nas srung ba'i bar phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing 'dod pa'i don rnams myur du 'grub pa dang yar rgyas gong 'phel gyi ched du dmigs nas 'bul zhing*/ sha chang bdud rtsi lngar dmigs pa ni mchog gi phyag rgya chen po rdo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i ched du 'bul/ lha sngags dngos gzhi'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis gang ba sku mdog dkar po phyag na ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag nas lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mer gyis khengs te rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mngon du byas byung snyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma yengs par bya zhing*/ mdun bskyed kyi sku las kyang 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bdag dang bsgrub bya la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsam/ yang gzhan don du byed na/ mdun bskyed kyi mdun du pad zla'i gdan bsgrub bya gang yin pa de rgyan gos dkar pos brgyan pa'i lus la mdun bskyed kyi 'od zer spro bsdus nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing*/ grangs gsog gi tshe rdzas til kho nas oṃ gsum ma thun re la gang 'gro re 'bul/ bsnyen sngags 'bum phrag bzhi song ba'i kha skong du khri phrag bzhi bskor bcas sngags kyang lha sngags kho nas 'bul la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang bsnyen pa kha bskang ba'i sngags lha rang rang gi dgos kyi/ rdzas sngags lha sngags ma yin pa'i phyir/ de'i phyag len rje sems dpa' chen pos bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i phyag len du gdams pa'i kha'u brag rdzong pa'i rjes zhugs tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes gtsang ma yin no// mthar yang lha sngags oṃ gsum ma rdzas sngags las sngags spel ba tshar res mgo drangs pa'i/

oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ye swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ nas dang*/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ye swā hā/ gro dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr+wa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ye swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ ma dā na pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ chang dang*/ oṃ bā la pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ba glang gi sha dum bcas kyis sngags rnams tshang bar bdun tsam phul/ slar yang rje btsun ma'i zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la yang ram̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇanī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar khu blugs gzar lan bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te thab la g.yon du bskor zhing rje btsun ma'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā di bya a bī ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye bdag gis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dang gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar gshegs skyems mar khu bdun tshan gsum phul nas phyag rgyar bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs nas/ ā khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/

nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlabs/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma chos skyong ba dang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod phul/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes nang mchod gtor/ bstod pa ni/ ḍā ma ru'i mgo 'dren gyis rol chen bya zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug na// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/

'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas su// rol mo glu dbyangs sgra snyan sogs mchod pa'i// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ phaiṃ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsam la/ thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi un+mā da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da yaḥ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi/ me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzigha tha/ piṃ pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+yaṃ/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes brjod/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung pa'i tshogs// ma lus par ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas kyis// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi// yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /ces phrin las bcol/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+ya me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+tāṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/

ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol// bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad par gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha bskong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥmadun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ zhes lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis se gol kha phyir bstan thog de nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thab dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs la gnas gsum du byug cing*/ dam tshig pa bdag la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim par gyur/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes go cha'i sngags rkyang pa tshar gsum brjod cing gsal btab/ yang mar blug gzar gang phul zhing oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las rang gzugs su byon par gyur par bsam/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/

dgang blugs kyi kha la ram̐ gyis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te thab la g.yon du bskor zhing me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la oṃ ag+na ye a dī pyā dī bya/ a bi ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye bdag gis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad dang gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de ltar gzhi nas skyems ma bdun tshon gsum phul nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams/ oṃ ag+na ye bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sogs lha sngags/ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye sogs rdzas sngags/ bdag gi sdig sgrib sogs las sngags tshar gcig gis sna drangs/ gzhan rdzas sngags rkyang pa grangs bdun dang bcu gcig sogs ci rigs phul te/ rdzas sngags oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ye swā hā/ til dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ye swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ ma hā be ga ye swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ye swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr+wa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ye swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ ma dā na pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ chang dang*/ oṃ bā la pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ ba glang gi sha dum gyi sngags so// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ/ zhes sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyi mchod phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par bstod// ces pas bstod/

gtor ma sngar byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid dran pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan lnga'am gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes phyi mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'byung ba yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas phrin las bcol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya sogs nas/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twaḥ.āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang*/ cho ga lhag pa dang chad par gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes lhag chad kha skong*/ me lha spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed cing*/ oṃ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub kyi bzhud cig byin za khyod// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad bsgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ thal ba sngar bzhin blangs la/ dam tshig pa rang la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrung*/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing*/ bsrung 'khor gsal btab la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sngags tshar gsum dang phyag rgya dang bcas pa phyogs g.yon skor mtshams g.yas skor gyis bsrung bar bya/ las bsags pa don dang ldan pa'i phyir bsngo ba smon lam mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i bar rgyun gyi nyams len bzhin dang*/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// sogs bkra shis brjod/ me tog gi char phab/ sbyin sreg nyi ma sbrel nas byed na thal ba dkrug brdal du ma song ba'i sngar gyi thal ba de nan pa byas pa'i khar lci ba brtsigs te cho ga rnams ni gong ji lta ba mdzad/ grol ba'i nyin tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i tshogs rdzas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha'i gtor ma 'bul tshar ma thag gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas sngags 'bul yan dkyus bzhin mdzad/ dam tshig spel ba dang*/ tshogs la longs spyod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas gnas gsum bsrung go cha'i lha sngags dang bsrung sngags brjod pa yan grub nas mdzad/ tshogs lhag nas bkra shis kyi bar rjes chog ma gtogs tshes bcu'i mchod pa ltar mdzad pas 'grub cing*/

thal shul chu dang 'o mas bkru zhing thal ba rnams mi phyugs mang pos 'thung ba'i chu bo'am/ ri mthon po'i rtser gdan drangs par bya'o// de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge rje sa chen yab sras sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig rnying dang*/ kun mkhyen go bo rin po ches mdzad pa dang*/ gtso bor rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i yi ge gzhir bzhag der mi gsal ba rnams bde kye'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nas kha 'gengs par gsungs pa bzhin kha skong bla ma yab sras kyi gsung rgyun bzhin dang phyag len gyis rim pa go bde bar byas/ don la rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos par sbyar ba 'di ni tshul 'di la mos pa'i don gnyer can gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams kyi bya bral ba dbang phyug rab brtan gyis yul dbus kyi sman ljongs/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i sras kyi thu bo rje
